product_metadata.title: DII Clothesline Collage, Photo Display Collection, Rustic Wood, 26x29.75"
features: DIY MULTI PHOTO COLLAGE: The cute clothesline photo hanger helps you to create the perfect DIY looking collage for your wall. Come with 30 clothesline clips - fit as many photos as you can depending on size.

CUTE & EASY DORM ROOM DECOR: Give your dorm room a makeover by frequently swapping or adding your favorite photos, customization is easy thanks to the 30 removable mini clothespins. Able to hang collage frame vertically or horizontally.
EASY TO SET UP & HANG: Includes everything you need to create a customizable collage of photos and hanging hardware to mount your art on the wall
MAKES A GREAT GIFT: Makes the perfect going away gift for your child that's going off to college, birthday gift, anniversary gift, Christmas, and so much more!
MEASUREMENTS: This unique multi-photo wall display measures 26x29.75 inches when assembled, 5 twine cords, and includes 30 mini clothespins
description: "This DIY floating photo display collage frame allows you to display many of your favorite pictures, memories, art work, drawings, prints, and so much more! Get back to school ready by sprucing up your home decor or dorm room with this creative and affordable DIY collage frame. Continuously stay trendy by frequently swapping or adding your favorite photos; customization is easy thanks to the 30 removable mini clothespins. The simple and traditional frame doesn't over power the look of your photos or artwork, so you can create any aesthetic for your room. Measures 26x29.75"" when assembled and includes 5 twine cords, 30 mini clothespins, and hanging hardware."
